items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And I finally got a chance to go with Woody Herman... And I stayed with Woody... I got a call from Woody to come back. So I came back, and I stayed with Woody until he broke up his band

ctx.x: Woody. Yeah, we beat 'em. Played the hard softball. That was funny. Boy, they were mad. They didn't think anybody could beat 'em; they were too good. I said, "You ain't too good. You're too busy at the bar."
